caption: The drawing features a dress with a fitted bodice and a full, tiered skirt composed of three distinct layers that flare outward. The dress has short sleeves with a puffed appearance and a wide neckline bordered with a triangular lace pattern. The bodice and skirt are predominantly colored in a red and off-white checkered pattern, with the red squares interlaced with irregular white lines, creating a textured effect. The sleeves follow the same checkered design as the skirt. The lace at the neckline is shaded in off-white and light brown tones. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a smaller outline drawing in black and white that provides a technical sketch of the dress from the back, showing the structural tiers and the sleeve shape. The background of the entire drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Dress
